**BLUF:** Ukrainian long-range strikes hit additional Russian oil infrastructure (Samara hub, Volgograd Lukoil refinery, Lipetsk-2 airfield) with fires reported, adding pressure on Russian fuel supplies and export blending. In the Gulf, IRGC claims of downing a US MQ-1 over Qeshm and mining incidents causing tanker fires in the Strait of Hormuz circulated alongside US reports of intercepting drones aimed at Bahrain; traffic remains heavily disrupted. PLA activity near Taiwan stayed at routine levels with 10 sorties and 4 median-line crossings. US FAA ground stop resolved overnight with no new major disruptions. No significant movement reported in quiet theatres.

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Multiple accounts including @warwatchh, @DI313_, @AzPetrich and @Mylovanov (14 Nov ~14:44–16:33 UTC) circulated claims and unverified video of renewed Ukrainian strikes on Lukoil’s Volgograd refinery and Lipetsk-2 airfield, with some linking the targets to reported Kushner/Witkoff discussions with Putin on refinery control; reach limited to a few thousand views, no independent geolocation or Russian confirmation in results.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)[[2]](https://x.com/Mylovanov/status/2121615272012550497)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @NewsTongueX, @JarlNordmabccy and @militarnyi (14 Nov ~11:05–13:38 UTC) posted photos and summaries of Ukrainian General Staff claims of strikes on Samara linear production control station (oil storage tanks on fire) and Lipetsk-2 airfield (hangar, fuel tank, command facility hit); posts amplified Ukrainian reporting with no contradictory Russian posts in results.[[3]](https://x.com/NewsTongueX/status/2121598529147654447)[[4]](https://x.com/militarnyi/status/2121644616273518917)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @TinTheTip, @grok and @Namkaribou (14 Nov ~16:41–17:00 UTC) summarized IRGC claims of intercepting a US MQ-1 over Qeshm Island and two oil tankers striking mines and catching fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, alongside CENTCOM reports of shooting down two Iranian drones toward Bahrain with no damage; claims remain disputed with no independent confirmation of successful hits.[[5]](https://x.com/grok/status/2121645812899840245)[[6]](https://x.com/Namkaribou/status/2121645452496130553)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @CIC_OS (14 Nov ~15:03 UTC) reported Taiwan MND data of 10 PLA aircraft sorties (4 median-line crossings) and 8 PLAN ships around Taiwan in the prior 24 hours; routine level with no escalation noted in results.[[7]](https://x.com/CIC_OS/status/2121619925382959153)

searched: Volgograd refinery; Samara oil hub strike; Hormuz tanker mine OR fire; IRGC Bahrain OR Qeshm drone; PLA Taiwan median line OR ADIZ; Ukraine drone Samara OR Lipetsk

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent and Ukrainska Pravda (14 Nov) report Ukrainian long-range strikes on Samara oil hub (storage tanks on fire) and Lipetsk-2 airfield; General Staff confirms hits on maintenance hangar, fuel tank and command facility.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets including Kyiv Independent (14 Nov) note ongoing Russian strikes killing at least 7 and injuring 80 across Ukraine, with Zaporizhzhia hardest hit.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainska Pravda (14 Nov) reports Ukrainian Security Service strike on key Russian oil export preparation hub.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian deep strikes continue to target Russian energy and aviation sustainment nodes at a steady tempo, likely compounding fuel and maintenance pressures on Russian forces; Russian civilian casualties from reciprocal strikes remain high. Moderate confidence from multiple Ukrainian official and Western reporting streams.

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye and gCaptain (14 Nov) report IRGC claims of MQ-1 drone interception over Qeshm and oil tankers striking mines and burning in the Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM confirms intercepting two drones toward Bahrain.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets report 18 Muslim-majority countries condemning Israeli strike on Nasser hospital in Gaza.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

**Assessment:** Escalatory claims around Hormuz and Bahrain risk further shipping disruption and insurance spikes, though US intercepts appear to have prevented damage so far; Gaza hospital strikes continue to draw broad diplomatic condemnation. Moderate confidence from official statements and maritime reporting.

### INDO-PACIFIC
[OSINT - WEB] Taipei Times and Taiwan MND (14–15 Nov) report 10 PLA aircraft sorties including 4 median-line crossings plus naval vessels near Taiwan.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

**Assessment:** Activity remains at baseline “silent intimidation” levels with no surge or new carrier presence; unlikely to trigger immediate alert upgrades. High confidence from official Taiwanese reporting.

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window.

### AFRICA
[OSINT - WEB] Africanews (14 Nov) reports at least 44 dead in ADF (IS-linked) attack in DRC Ituri province.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

**Assessment:** ADF campaign in eastern DRC continues with high civilian toll; no new major shifts. Moderate confidence from humanitarian and security sources.

### AMERICAS
[OSINT - WEB] NPR, France 24 and others (14 Nov) confirm FAA nationwide ground stop lifted after equipment issue during telecom upgrade; full recovery ongoing.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

**Assessment:** Largest US air disruption in 25 years resolved without lasting infrastructure damage or confirmed malicious cause. High confidence from official FAA and DOT statements.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window beyond routine space weather (R0–R1 levels).

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain (14 Nov) reports ongoing Hormuz shipping disruption with oil exports recovering elsewhere.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

**Assessment:** Hormuz incidents add to existing chokepoint pressure but have not yet produced measurable global supply shock. Moderate confidence from maritime tracking.

leads worked: 3 of 5 recent Bohai/Yellow Sea nav warnings carried (ongoing exercises 15–29 Nov); GDELT hotspots Washington (FAA), Tehran/Bahrain (drone claims), Gaza (hospital) searched and carried where substantiated; Kyiv, Moscow carried via Ukraine/Russia strikes.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (14 Nov) reports US disruption of North Korean “FaceStealer” campaign behind $400 million crypto theft.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

[OSINT - WEB] CISA KEV additions (13 Nov) for UnrealIRCd and Check Point vulnerabilities.[[1]](https://x.com/warwatchh/status/2121642725946585357)

searched: CISA KEV headlines; no significant new X chatter on active exploitation.

**Assessment:** State-linked crypto theft campaign disrupted; routine vulnerability catalog updates with no confirmed widespread active exploitation in window. Moderate confidence from official and industry reporting.

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA ground stop.

searched: Brooklyn building collapse — no significant additional X chatter beyond news reposts.

**Assessment:** No new major domestic incidents. High confidence from absence in headlines and searches.

## FORECAST CHECK
1. TRIGGERED - Ukrainian strikes on major Russian refineries/oil hubs confirmed in Samara and Volgograd (Section 2).
2. OPEN - Hormuz mining/tanker incidents reported but no verified successful IRGC/proxy strike on US/Gulf assets or major new insurance spike yet.
3. NOT TRIGGERED - Only 4 median-line crossings reported, well below >20 threshold.
4. OPEN - Damage to Volgograd refinery confirmed but sustained shutdown or measurable output loss not yet independently verified.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Additional Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining capacity or Black Sea assets within 48 h → measurable Russian fuel shortages or export disruption → first on Ukrainian General Staff or Russian regional governors → likely.
- Verified IRGC or proxy success against US/Gulf assets or sustained Hormuz mining → insurance spike and shipping diversion → first on CENTCOM or UKMTO reports → roughly even chance.
- >20 PLA aircraft with median-line crossings or new carrier transit within 24 h → Taiwanese alert upgrade or US statement → first on @MoNDefense → unlikely.
- Independent verification of Volgograd or Samara facility shutdown → European fuel price pressure → first on Kyiv Independent or industry sources → likely.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of damage extent and operational impact at Samara and Volgograd facilities.
- Status of Hormuz tanker incidents and any mine threat persistence.
- Russian official response or denial of latest Ukrainian strikes.

sections.Solar Activity: Past 24 h: Solar activity remained at low levels with C-class flares observed. Newly numbered Region 4579 (N15E79, Hsx/alpha) produced a C5.5 flare at 13/1821 UTC, the largest of the period, as well as the majority of the other C-flares observed. Region 4568 (S08W60, Axx/alpha) added a C4.4 flare at 14/0606 UTC, while a few other regions contributed smaller C-flares during the period. Regions 4574 (N16E27, Dso/beta), 4576 (S17W30, Dai/beta-gamma), and 4577 (S06E11, Dso/beta) all experienced growth during the period, while the remaining regions were stable or in decay. No Earth-directed CMEs were observed in available coronagraph imagery.  Forecast: Solar activity is expected to be low with a chance for M-class flares (R1-R2, Minor-Moderate) over 14-16 Nov.
sections.Energetic Particle: Past 24 h: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux reached high levels with a peak flux of 5,223 pfu observed at 13/1700 UTC. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux was at background levels.  Forecast: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux is expected to reach high levels through 16 Nov. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux is expected to continue at background levels on 14-16 Nov.
sections.Solar Wind: Past 24 h: Solar wind parameters reflected a near background solar wind regime. Total field ranged from 3-6 nT while the Bz component was variable between +/-4 nT. Solar wind speed was mainly between 350-400 km/s until ~14/1100 UTC when it saw a slight increase to around 430 km/s. Phi was in a mostly negative orientation.  Forecast: Nominal solar wind conditions are expected on 14-15 Nov. A gradual increase in solar wind parameters is expected on 16 Nov due to an SSBC in advance of a positive polarity CH HSS.
sections.Geospace: Past 24 h: The geomagnetic field was quiet.  Forecast: Mostly quiet conditions are expected on 14-15 Nov, with an increase to unsettled to isolated active periods on 16 Nov as the CH HSS moves into a geoeffective position.
